name: Argon2 Key Derivation & Password Hasher
desc: Compute and verify Argon2id, Argon2i and Argon2d password hashes in your browser: set memory, iterations, parallelism and salt, and get a standard PHC-encoded hash. Nothing is uploaded.

name: BIP39 Mnemonic Phrase Generator & Seed Verifier
desc: Understand and test BIP39 mnemonic phrases: generate 12-24 word phrases, verify the checksum and wordlist, and see the PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 seed. For learning and test wallets only — never real seeds.

name: ChaCha20
desc: Encrypt and decrypt with ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (RFC 8439) in your browser: 256-bit key, 96-bit nonce, AAD and a 128-bit tag. Matches the RFC test vector. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Diceware Passphrase Generator
desc: Generate high-entropy, human-memorable cryptographic passphrases offline using the EFF Diceware standard and hardware CSPRNG in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero telemetry, zero network egress.

name: HMAC Generator & Keyed
desc: Compute and verify Hash-based Message Authentication Codes (HMAC-SHA256, HMAC-SHA512, HMAC-SHA384, HMAC-SHA1) with secret keys locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: PBKDF2 Key Derivation & Password Hasher
desc: Derive cryptographic keys and compute PBKDF2 hashes using HMAC-SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-512, and HMAC-SHA-1 with customizable iterations and salts locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: PGP & OpenPGP Text Encryptor, Decryptor & Key Generator
desc: Encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, and generate OpenPGP armor keys and messages locally in browser RAM. Zero tracking, zero network egress, RFC 4880 / RFC 9580 compliant.

name: RSA Key Pair Generator & Key Inspector
desc: Generate cryptographically secure RSA key pairs (2048, 3072, 4096-bit) and export in PEM (PKCS#1, PKCS#8, SPKI) or JWK formats locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme (SSSS)
desc: Split sensitive passphrases, seed phrases, or cryptographic private keys into (k, n) threshold shares and reconstruct payloads offline in browser RAM using Shamir

name: TOTP & HOTP Authenticator Token Generator
desc: Generate and verify RFC 6238 TOTP and RFC 4226 HOTP two-factor authentication codes locally in browser memory. Decode Base32 seeds and otpauth:// URIs with zero network egress.

name: UUID / GUID Generator & Inspector
desc: Generate and validate cryptographically secure RFC 4122 and RFC 9562 UUIDs (Version 4 Random, Version 7 Time-Ordered, Version 1, and Nil) locally in browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
